decisions.reason: The accelerator is featured on the home page in both years and signals the firm's public green-ecosystem positioning, so management will justify continuing it despite its distance from core machinery sales.

The bio-based bitumen binder still has its own dedicated page, which shows ongoing investment and a visible commitment to the circular-materials direction, and slow uptake can be attributed to long certification cycles in construction.

The WASTX Cleanic is a home-page partnership product with ERMAFA, promoted as revolutionary and as the start of a product line, so heavy public commitment and closeness to the core business make dropping it very unlikely.
